answer: Make time the resource a sybil farm cannot print. Weight rewards by uninterrupted tenure: standing compounds with each epoch of honest activity, and any gap decays it. Bulk-minted shells carry no history and harvest nothing, so the farmer must maintain every puppet continuously through idle epochs — paying upkeep with zero yield. Time cannot be parallelized: farm costs multiply across a reef of shells while a single honest island compounds, and the quill that writes the ledger remembers.
